Name: Massive Farm
Author: N3rdGirl64
Description:
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/0PPnuQJ.png[/img]
This mod is tailored to a co-op style of play, however, it will work as a single player save too. The map itself is 185x150 and contains a small warp room in order to more easily get around. There are areas for foraging, and mining. In order to get around the map faster there are also warp spots.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RK7MTYt.png[/img]
For this mod you will need content patcher and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]. Make sure content patcher and FTM are in the mods folder and drop this mod into the mods folder too. Depending on how you play, you may need to select the right arrow on the farm selector for the character creation screen.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b6c2IjM.png[/img]
This mod is compatible with most mods, it will not be compatible with other farm map as you can really only have one custom farm.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/prY2LJu.png[/img]
If you have any issues with this mod then please make a bug report and provide me with your [url=http://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3IoxJ6a.png[/img]﻿
If you would like to add translations for this mod, please reach out to me via [url=https://github.com/N3rdGirl64/Stardew-Mods]GitHub[/url]﻿ where you can follow the directions for submitting Translations.
Any and all custom tiles are free to be edited by anyone. Most of them are retextured vanilla textures[/size]
